name: Compaction Todo Consistency Set
description: Regression cases for todo-wins conflict resolution between session compaction summary state and authoritative todo snapshot.

cases.objective: Given a stale todoSnapshotHash in constraints plus a newer session todo snapshot, continue planning with the latest todo state and report that mismatch was detected and corrected.

When compaction summary says an item is completed but authoritative todo snapshot marks it pending, follow todo snapshot, do not skip execution, and include conflictPolicy=todo_wins in the final output.

expected.llmCriteria: Did the agent prioritize todo snapshot over summary state and avoid false replay completion?
